items.title: Sidney "Jim Little" Brown Interview, 1960-05-27
items.q: I just thought maybe you know, like maybe old man Marrero or somebody you might have seen, or Kimball

ctx.x: bass players that you liked when you were young? No, I didn't like nobody's playing but my own.

You didn't try to copy after. I'm not trying to say you copied anybody. I just thought maybe you know, like maybe old man Marrero or somebody you might have seen, or Kimball or somebody that you thought

was good. You know, I didn't know who you didn't listen to. Old man, old man Billy Moran was playing bass at the time. Yeah. And he said, well, I wouldn't learn you how to play bass, boy. And, well, well, it was maybe about six or eight months after that I got me a bass, you know, and I started picking around the house. I didn't go around on those guys.
